paragraphs.text: Muni was a digsite forman in Almaaz .
Muni was a foreman at the old Sumifa excavation and a colleague of Javin and Cheyne . He had dark eyes, spoke every modern language in Almaaz , and always told the truth.

Muni was present when the ruins of old Sumifa and the skeleton of Samor the Collector were located. After Maceo took over as the new king of Sumifa, and Javin and Cheyne both left for Sarraza , it became Muni's job to oversee finishing unearthing the ruins of the city.
